question: Should maintainers repair this ClawSweeper-authored forward-port and then capture or override proof for the repaired head, or pause/close the replacement?
rationale: The code defect is mechanically repairable, but the existing proof-decision comment is a maintainer-owned gate for a bot-authored release forward-port.

options.title: Repair then decide proof
options.body: Fix the duplicate type and conflicts, rerun focused validation, then either attach real proof or apply a maintainer proof override before merge.

options.title: Pause or close replacement
options.body: Leave the PR blocked or close it if maintainers no longer want to carry this alpha forward-port back to main.

recommendation.title: Repair then decide proof
recommendation.body: Fix the duplicate type and conflicts, rerun focused validation, then either attach real proof or apply a maintainer proof override before merge.
